verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is itself a terminal-based AI coding agent with an official `mastracode` CLI. Its headless mode supports `--prompt`/`-p` single-task runs, stdin piping, a final JSON output object, timeout exit codes and tool-approval policies, and `mastracode update` handles self-updates. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs and probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Mastra Code is a terminal-based AI coding agent
